Q1: If no bad help strings turn up, step 3 adds `--help` exit-0 tests only for the scripts "that tests in those two CI jobs call". Which jobs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` does that mean?
Choices:
A) `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` and `tests-promote-stall-and-review`, which cover the clarify, plan, review and judge paths that broke on Python 3.14 (RECOMMENDED)
B) `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and `orchestrate-poll`
C) `tests-release-and-log-analysis` and `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`
D) All five test jobs (`tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`, `tests-promote-stall-and-review`, `tests-release-and-log-analysis`, `orchestrate-poll`), so every argparse script a CI test calls gets a `--help` test
E) A different pair. Name the two job IDs in your `/answer`.
